sections.html: The natural distribution is the upper basin of the Rio Tapajós.

Peter and Martin Hoffmann were able to obtain some imported specimens and were already successful in breeding them. They reported on this in the Datz magazine 11/2017. Aquarium-bred fish of German origin all derive from this stock.

The species was described only in 2016. The scientists who described it honour the Brazilian aquarium enthusiast and breeder Luiz Wada. This tetra has been a popular aquarium fish in São Paulo (Brazil) for several years. The common name is "blueberry tetra" ("blackberry tetra" in German).
